svg.title: Burri Rules v0.1 — Canonical Proof Plate
svg.desc: Ivory proof plate showing the typed D0-D6 spine, Titan boundary frame, D5 option field, D4 commitment and receipt, reflexive return, collective trace boundary, and removable quantum correspondence.

g.text: 01 Cognitive gap: prediction or representation versus observed receipt
02 Execution gap: authorized action versus action actually carried out
03 Outcome gap: carried-out action versus consequence received
− Negative / corrective feedback contracts a declared error
+ Positive / amplifying feedback enlarges a deviation or self-confirming tendency
THESE ARE DYNAMICAL SIGNS, NOT MORAL VERDICTS; THE COLLECTIVE BOUNDARY SUPPLIES THE MORAL TEST.
NO CONSCIOUSNESS CLAIM: PERSISTENCE, SELECTION EFFECT, REPRODUCED BIAS, AND CONTINUING COST DO NOT ESTABLISH A CONSCIOUS SUPER-AGENT.
rho_domain → TYPE- AND TIER-PRESERVING PROJECTION WITH NO PROOF TRANSFER BETWEEN DOMAINS; PARTIAL AND FAILED MAPPINGS REMAIN LAWFUL OUTPUTS.

text.tspan: The Titans frame possibility; a finite agent forms a fallible D5 option field, commits through D4 means and authorization, receives D4 consequences, and recursively corrects
